filter_note: V1 set (7) + market briefing + AI news; Today window = Mon Oct 19 – Tue Oct 20 PT

market_briefing.lede: Agent software is being repriced and re-plumbed around metered work. Notion folded all AI usage into one credit pool with a cost-routing default and promised per-agent spend limits, while quoting vendor Vendavo is opening its CPQ to calls from other agents, with field-level entitlements and an audit trail on every approval.

bullets.text: Credits, routing and spend controls become the agent pricing model: Notion (Oct 19) moved all Notion AI usage onto a new credit system, made its Auto router the default (the company says results are similar to Opus 5.5 and Astra at about 90% lower average cost across 20+ tasks), gave agents their own computer and browser for tasks up to 24 hours, and announced an AI Command Center (coming soon) for usage by person and agent, spending limits and model allow-lists.

Deal desks become agent-callable services: Vendavo's AI Deal Desk Assistant (Oct 20) answers renewal and pricing questions inside the quote, and Vendavo is extending it to draft quotes from call transcripts, run approvals against margin rules, and accept agent-to-agent quote requests from CRM, with field-level entitlements and audited approvals. Productivity and margin figures are company claims.

Inbound follow-up is where sales agents are landing in production: at Salesforce's AIforce Sydney event (Oct 20), Lawpath said it runs Agentforce SDR agents with a sales team of about 25 on an all-inbound model, for membership win-backs and enquiries left uncontacted for five days; voice agents are still in testing.

biggest_ai_news.title: OpenAI races to raise about $30B at a valuation above $1.4T
biggest_ai_news.body: Reuters (Oct 19, two sources): OpenAI wants commitments before Anthropic's expected mid-November IPO; SoftBank and MGX are in talks to join. OpenAI is pitching investors on $50B annualized revenue and expects $70B by year-end, according to one source. OpenAI and SoftBank declined to comment.

biggest_ai_news.title: Google packages Gemini for government services
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 20: a preview agentic solution for US federal, state and local agencies, with prebuilt skills, connectors to agency systems, inherited identity and access controls, and third-party partner agents. It follows Gemini for legal and Gemini for financial services.

biggest_ai_news.title: Claude runs a 64-hour, mostly autonomous protein-design campaign
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 20: an internal Anthropic research model generated 318,484 designs against scorpion neurotoxins over 64 hours with four human follow-ups; 17 of 211 lab-tested designs met the binding criteria. Neutralization was not tested.

what_changed.title: Salesforce signs definitive agreement to acquire Braze for about $5.66B
what_changed.body: NEW (watchlist, M&A). Oct 20: all cash at $47.50 per Braze share; Braze's real-time engagement and AI decisioning are expected to complement Data 360, Customer 360, Agentforce and SIForce and strengthen Marketing Cloud's cross-channel personalization. Braze has about 2,770 customers (Canva, Instacart, Venmo). Close expected in Salesforce's fiscal 2028; no change to FY27 guidance. Braze shares were up about 51% and Salesforce down 0.6% by 10:10 a.m. ET.

what_changed.title: Notion rebuilds its agents and moves AI to a single credit system
what_changed.body: NEW (category). Oct 19: agents get their own computer and browser, a "Review for me" mode with safety checks, and tasks up to 24 hours; Auto model router is the default; bring-your-own ChatGPT plan or API key (private alpha for Enterprise); Notion MCP overhaul with memory sync; AI Command Center for spend limits and model allow-lists is coming soon.

what_changed.title: Vendavo AI Deal Desk Assistant, with agent-to-agent quoting on the roadmap
what_changed.body: NEW (category). Oct 20: natural-language renewal and pricing answers inside Vendavo Quoting; being extended to transcript-to-quote drafting, AI-driven approvals and quotes started by other agents from CRM, with field-level entitlements and audit trails.

what_changed.title: Salesforce AIforce Sydney: Agentforce SDR agents in production at Lawpath
what_changed.body: NEW (watchlist, soft). Oct 20: Lawpath uses Agentforce SDR agents for win-backs and enquiries left uncontacted for five days, with voice agents in testing; Gumtree's Agentforce service agent replaced Einstein Bots in late September. Customer stories at an event, not a product launch.

Close expected in fiscal 2028, subject to Braze shareholder and regulatory approval (Oct 20).

watch.title: Salesforce's October GAs: Agent Optimizer and AI Skills
watch.body: Eleven days left in October and Salesforce still hasn't published a GA flag or pricing for Agent Optimizer (beta through account executives since Sep 21) or AI Skills in Agentforce Coworker (pilot). A third-party Salesforce Diary post on Oct 19 repeats that Optimizer "goes GA in October 2026" but isn't confirmation. Watch release notes and the newsroom before month-end, and whether Braze decisioning shows up in Agentforce roadmap language.

interpretation.fact: Salesforce agreed to acquire Braze for about $5.66B (Oct 20). Notion moved all AI usage to one credit system with Auto routing and agents that have their own computer and browser (Oct 19). Vendavo launched an AI Deal Desk Assistant with agent-to-agent quoting planned (Oct 20). Lawpath described Agentforce SDR agents in production at AIforce Sydney (Oct 20). Reuters reported OpenAI is seeking about $30B at over $1.4T (Oct 19). Google launched Gemini for government services in preview (Oct 20). Anthropic published a 64-hour Claude protein-design campaign (Oct 20).
interpretation.note: Light interpretation: Salesforce is buying the real-time engagement and decisioning layer rather than building it, which widens the suite it can sell against point tools on the marketing side; on the sales side, the new pattern across Notion and Vendavo is metered agent work with spend limits, entitlements and audit built in, which is likely to become a standard buyer checklist.
